title: BANCO DE TALENTOS - ESCRITÓRIO (Rio de Janeiro)
description:
BANCO DE TALENTOS - ESCRITÓRIO (Rio de Janeiro)

BANCO DE TALENTOS - ESCRITÓRIO (Rio de Janeiro)

Descrição da vaga
Não encontrou a vaga que procurava? Deixe seu currículo com a gente!
Seu perfil ficará armazenado em nosso banco e poderemos entrar em contato quando surgir uma nova oportunidade .
Conheça nossas áreas corporativas:

  • Departamento Pessoal:
  • Admissão de Pessoas:

Tem por atribuição adequar nas funções do cargo, de acordo com as conformidades da legislação do trabalho.
  • Compensação de Pessoas:

Tem por atribuição efetuar todos os processos (elaboração da folha de pagamento, encargos sociais, eSocial, benefícios, frequência, afastamentos).
  • Desligamento de Pessoal:

Tem por atribuição zelar por todo o processo de desligamento e quitação do controle de trabalho.
  • Gente e Gestão:
  • Recrutamento & Seleção:

Recrutar talentos para os cargos de loja e escritório.
  • Treinamento e Desenvolvimento:

Criar e aplicar treinamentos para desenvolvimento dos colaboradores.
  • Desenvolvimento Humano (DHO):

Gerenciar metas, aplicar avaliações de desempenho, avaliações de atendimento, programa de desenvolvimento individual, pesquisas de clima, entre outros.
  • Comunicação Interna e Endomarketing:

Gerenciar a comunicação corporativa, engajar colaboradores e promover a cultura e o clima organizacional.
  • Operações:

Definir melhorias dos processos referentes à operação de loja no intuito de agilizar a rotina da equipe de vendas e proporcionar uma melhor experiência de compra para os clientes;
Criar procedimentos, comunicar e realizar treinamentos com a equipe de loja com o objetivo de padronizar as ações da rede de lojas;
Criar, comunicar e fazer gestão da premiação da equipe de loja realizando análises e controlando os pagamentos;
Montar, divulgar e analisar reports de indicadores de venda de loja e quadros de desempenho de vendedores.
  • Obras e Infraestruturas:

Supervisionar e controlar a área de manutenção e serviços;
Gestão operacional dos serviços de infraestrutura predial: manutenção civil, elétrica, ar condicionado, sistema de prevenção e combate à incêndio, reformas, alterações de layouts e obras;
Supervisionar contratos de prestadores de serviços;
Contas: Manutenção, obras, energia elétrica e ar condicionado.
  • Produto:

Definição de sortimento e mix de produtos;
Acompanhamento do abastecimento e distribuição de produtos para as lojas;
Definição de preço acompanhando as estratégias da categoria e promoções do varejo;
Gestão do ciclo de vida dos produtos acompanhando giro de estoque, cobertura e desempenho por loja;
Gestão orçamentária - planejamento de compra e gestão das despesas da categoria;
Negociação com fornecedores, desenvolvimento de coleção e follow-up semanal até a entrega da produção;
Suporte ao departamento de marketing para da criação de campanhas, sugestão de produtos para catálogos e mídias e ações de promoção;
Pesquisa de mercado e monitoramento dos principais concorrentes;
Atendimento às solicitações de loja.
  • Criação:

Responsável por pesquisar, planejar, desenvolver e conceber os produtos que serão lançadas pela empresa.
  • Planejamento Financeiro:

Responsável por realizar uma projeção de receitas e despesas que tem por finalidade indicar a situação econômica geral da empresa.
  • Contábil/Fiscal:
  • Departamento Fiscal:

Escriturar todas as movimentações de mercadorias (entradas e saídas);
Apurar os impostos;
Garantir que todas as obrigações legais sejam cumpridas;
Estudos em busca de benefícios fiscais, redução de custos e créditos de impostos para compensação.
  • Departamento Contábil:

Registrar e demonstrar as movimentações do Patrimônio.
  • Tesouraria:

Analisa e efetua todos os pagamentos;
Controla e valida todos os recebimentos;
Gestão das contas bancárias e administração do fluxo de caixa;
Aprovação de crédito para vendas em cheque;
Cobrança;
Negociação e captação de recursos Financeiros.
  • Logística:
  • E-commerce:

Vendas, fechamento de pedidos e entrega para transportadora; trocas e devoluções.
  • Malote & Troca:

Recebimento e envio de malotes, recebimento de Sedex, recebimento de peças com defeito e troca e devolução de loja física.
  • Estoque parado:

Recebimento de peças sem conserto e tratativa com fornecedores.
  • Controle de qualidade:

Recebimento de pedidos, controle de qualidade e etiquetagem.
  • Equipe Cofre:

Recebimento de transferências, atendimento de demonstração e pré-venda, transferência de peças para lojas e departamentos.
  • Supply:

Gestão de fornecedores, gestão de pedidos de compra, processo de demonstração, mapeamento de processos e indicadores da logística.
  • Suprimentos & Expedição:
  • Estoque:

Responsável pelo recebimento, controle, separação e distribuição dos materiais de expediente, embalagens de terceiros e uniformes.
  • Expedição:

Responsável pelo planejamento e controle dos envios e recebimentos dos malotes entre lojas e escritório. Controle de gasolina e rotas dos motoboys.
  • Compras:

Responsável pela cotação e compra de materiais de expediente, uniforme, embalagens e serviços de transporte. Controle de pagamentos do setor.
  • Marketing:

Construir valor e demanda;
Estratégia de comunicação;
Publicidade;
Eventos;
Trade Marketing;
Digital;
Visual Merchandising;
Assessoria de Imprensa;
Metodologia Go To Market.
  • E-commerce:
  • Design:

Criação de Landing Pages / Lead Pages ou qualquer outra página de conteúdo do site;
Manutenção do ambiente VTEX;
Implementação de novos módulos VTEX;
Garantir qualidade na comunicação visual da comunicação online, preservando identidade da marca.
  • Site:

Controlar fluxo de produtos da distribuição a subida das peças no e-commerce, dando ritmo ao processo;
Garantir o sucesso de lançamentos e produtos no site;
Garantir a população de conteúdo, organização e harmonia do e-commerce;
Fortalecer a identidade da marca (Branding) nos meios digitais, facilitando a comunicação da marca com as clientes, contribuindo com a venda online e offine;
Mídia performance.
  • SAC:

Excelência no atendimento, encantando e retendo clientes;
Garantir a satisfação das Monte Carlo quanto ao processo de devolução dos produtos adquiridos no site;
Dar suporte a equipe de atendimento quanto as informações relacionadas a transportadoras.
Requisitos e qualificações
Requisitos:
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar na Barra da Tijuca - Rio de Janeiro;

Informações adicionais
Benefícios:
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação;
  • Vale-transporte;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Happy Day;
  • Casual Friday;
  • Desconto especiais em produtos da marca;
  • Desconto em faculdades parceiras;
  • Código Colaborador;
  • Possibilidade de crescimento.
  • Todas as vagas da Monte Carlo aceitam candidatura PCD.

Somos a Monte Carlo Joias. Onde tudo pode ser extraordinário.
Uma rede de joalherias que torna momentos inesquecíveis com luxo e design.
Inauguramos nossa primeira loja em 1981 e hoje somos uma das maiores joalherias do país com aproximadamente 50 lojas em todos as regiões do Brasil. Somos mais de 500 colaboradores entre escritório, lojas, fábrica e assistência técnica (DAT).
Valorizamos pessoas que tem brilho nos olhos e que está sempre buscando entregar a melhor experiência para o nosso cliente.
Buscamos pessoas que tenham Visão de Dono , sendo comprometidas e apaixonadas pelo nosso negócio, que sejam Simples e descomplicadas. Pessoas inconformadas, Criativas no dia a dia e que adorem de colocar a mão na massa e aprender fazendo.
Somos apaixonados pelo que fazemos e pela Nossa Gente . Desenvolvemos e mantemos os talentos que buscam desafios reais e que querem crescer e apresentar seus resultados com foco no Nosso Cliente .
Acreditamos que trabalhando juntos chegamos mais longe e podemos alcançar o nosso propósito que é Celebrar quem escolhe brilhar!

title: Analista de Produto Jr.
description:
Overview

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Produto para atuar no Rio de Janeiro, com foco em gestão de portfólio, planejamento de demanda e análise de desempenho. Se você tem perfil analítico e gosta de trabalhar com dados, essa pode ser a oportunidade certa para você.

Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar o portfólio de produtos, assegurando a adequação nos diversos pontos de venda.
  • Planejar e monitorar a previsão de demanda, identificando tendências e sazonalidades.
  • Controlar o estoque, equilibrando a disponibilidade de produtos sem acúmulos excessivos.
  • Analisar precificação para maximizar resultados.
  • Criar e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho, identificando oportunidades de melhorias.
  • Desenvolver análises detalhadas para apoiar a tomada de decisões em níveis estratégicos.

O Que Buscamos

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento avançado no Pacote Office.
  • Inglês intermediário.

Idiomas

  • Inglês - Nível Intermediário

title: Analista de Dados SR - Qualidade de Dados - Corporativo RJ
description:
Overview

Analista de Dados SR - Qualidade de Dados - Corporativo RJ

Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Tecnologia, áreas afins
  • Experiência em:
  • MDM e Governança de Dados: domínios, golden record, match/merge, survivorship, hierarquias, SCD, stewardship
  • Especificação funcional/técnica para desenvolvimento em IBM DataStage e homologação (massa de teste, critérios de aceite)
  • Qualidade de dados: perfilamento, regras de validação, deduplicação, monitoramento de KPIs
  • Git básico e documentação técnica/funcional
  • SSIS: criação/manutenção de pacotes, parametrização, logging, orquestração e deploy
  • MongoDB: modelagem e pipelines de agregação (nível intermediário)
  • APIs e Integrações: REST/JSON e XML, autenticação (Bearer/OAuth2), leitura de Swagger/OpenAPI; testes com Postman/Insomnia
  • Conhecimentos em:
  • SQL avançado em Oracle e SQL Server
  • Excel avançado (Power Query, Tabelas Dinâmicas, funções de procura)

Atividades

  • Liderar iniciativas de governança e qualidade de dados nos domínios MDM
  • Traduzir demandas do negócio em requisitos claros e especificações MDM/DQ
  • Definir regras de duplicação, match rules e survivorship; tratar exceções
  • Desenvolver e manter pacotes SSIS e consultas SQL para DQ, relatórios e pipelines de apoio
  • Mapear integrações, testar APIs (contratos, cenários de erro) e evidenciar resultados
  • Definir, medir e reportar KPIs/SLAs de qualidade e publicação do MDM
  • Conduzir curadoria/stewardship, reconciliações e análises de causa raiz
  • Manter dicionário de dados, glossário, fluxos de governança e decisões sempre atualizados junto ao time de governança de dados

Outras informações

- Escala: Seg a qui das 08 às 18 h, sexta das 08 às 17h (Modelo híbrido).

title: Especialista de Marketing  - Rio de Janeiro/RJ
description:
Overview

Alqia Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Estamos em busca de talentos para integrar nosso time. Procuramos alguém que compartilhe nossos valores e atue com foco em resultados. Você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar ao lado de profissionais que são referência no mercado, colaborando para alcançar metas e contribuir com o crescimento da Alqia. Se você é uma pessoa comprometida, curiosa, inovadora e focada, aqui encontrará um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, que valoriza e recompensa quem vai além.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver relacionamento com lojistas, todo o ecossistema Bossa Nova Mall, prospectar parcerias e estabelecer relacionamento com empresas do entorno;
  • Gerir o PEX de Marketing;
  • Realizar pesquisas com clientes visando ampliar o conhecimento do consumidor do shopping para melhorar a conversão e fornecer insumos para a área comercial;
  • Gerir redes sociais, agência de comunicação online e offline e assessoria de imprensa: criar briefings para comunicação interna e externa, validar pautas semanais e releases;
  • Executar o planejamento de marketing validado, incluindo eventos e ativações para aumento de fluxo, conversão de vendas e ações de trade;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de material comercial e parcerias com a área de mídia.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação completa em Marketing, Administração, Jornalismo, Publicidade e Propaganda ou áreas afins;
  • Ferramentas de edições de imagens e vídeos;
  • Experiência no mercado de Shopping Center é um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em redes sociais, FB e IG (lives, darks, timeline e stories);
  • Conhecimento intermediário em ferramentas office (Excel, Word, Power Point);
  • Interesse em soluções, curiosidade, fome de conhecimento, autonomia e espírito de colaboração.

Informações adicionais

  • Performance: PLR (Participação nos Lucros e Resultados) - de acordo com atingimento de metas.
  • Alimentação e Transporte: vale refeição (cartão flexível); vale transporte.
  • Saúde e Bem-estar: Bradesco Seguros (assistência médica e odontológica com coparticipação), saúde digital e telemedicina, TotalPass (desconto em academias), MetLife (seguro de vida).
  • HSImpulsiona: fortalecimento da liderança feminina no ambiente corporativo; Jornada da Liderança e Novos Líderes.

Local

#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Coordenador(a) de Marketing
description:
Overview

Nuuvem é a maior plataforma de distribuição de jogos digitais da América Latina. Com uma presença consolidada no mercado, procuramos um talento para fazer parte da nossa guilda de proplayers, conquistando muito XP ao longo do caminho. Estamos construindo algo grande: uma plataforma revolucionária que promete transformar a forma como os jogadores acessam e experimentam games. Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Marketing apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, com experiência em campanhas integradas, redes sociais, PR e construção de comunidades. Esta pessoa será responsável por estruturar e fortalecer a presença da marca em diferentes canais, conectando-se com públicos estratégicos por meio de uma comunicação criativa, estruturada e orientada a resultados. Atuará de forma estratégica e hands-on, liderando e desenvolvendo o time, além de gerenciar parcerias, conteúdos e relacionamento com influenciadores e stakeholders para gerar engajamento, visibilidade e novos negócios. Esta oportunidade é para trabalho remoto. Fornecemos os equipamentos necessários e você pode trabalhar de onde estiver, desde que garanta uma internet de qualidade.

Formação completa em Comunicação, Marketing, Publicidade, Jornalismo, Relações Públicas ou áreas correlatas. Experiência em planejamento e execução de estratégias de go-to-market para produtos digitais, incluindo lançamentos, atualizações e gestão de comunidades. Vivência em relacionamento com influenciadores, parcerias estratégicas (IP, publishers, marcas) e ações de PR, com histórico de geração de visibilidade e engajamento. Experiência em liderança de equipes e interface com diferentes stakeholders, incluindo gestão de community manager, agências e creators. Capacidade de desenvolver e executar planos de comunicação integrados (conteúdo, PR, social orgânica), alinhados aos objetivos do negócio. Sólidos conhecimentos em redes sociais, criação de conteúdo e estratégias para crescimento e engajamento de comunidades gamers e devs. Perfil hands-on, com capacidade de planejar e executar ações, incluindo gerenciamento de cronogramas, budget (quando aplicável) e acompanhamento de métricas. Inglês fluente, com segurança para produção de conteúdo, reuniões e contatos com stakeholders internacionais. Espanhol é um diferencial. Organização, pensamento estruturado e visão analítica para interpretar dados e ajustar estratégias continuamente.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Planejar e executar estratégias de go-to-market para lançamentos, novas features e SDKs, garantindo visibilidade e engajamento contínuo.

  • Liderar o trabalho da equipe e coordenar ações de comunicação, PR e social orgânica, alinhadas aos objetivos do projeto.

  • Gerenciar relacionamento com influenciadores, publishers, marcas parceiras e demais stakeholders para ampliar alcance e fortalecer a plataforma.

  • Construir e manter relacionamento com desenvolvedores, entendendo suas necessidades e produzindo conteúdos estratégicos (press releases, artigos, vídeos, social posts) voltados para gamedevs e gamers, garantindo consistência de mensagem e comunicação eficaz com a comunidade.

  • Participar de eventos e feiras relevantes do setor (GDC, DevCom/Gamescom, BIG Festival, entre outros), promovendo networking e visibilidade para o projeto.

  • Monitorar KPIs como wishlists, plays, envios de novos jogos e menções espontâneas, propondo melhorias com base em dados.

  • Garantir consistência do tom de voz e posicionamento da marca em todos os canais de comunicação.

  • Colaborar com Produto, Tech e demais áreas para alinhar estratégia de comunicação com o roadmap e as iniciativas da plataforma.

Requisitos

  • Formação completa em Comunicação, Marketing, Publicidade, Jornalismo, Relações Públicas ou áreas correlatas.

  • Experiência em planejamento e execução de estratégias de go-to-market para produtos digitais, incluindo lançamentos, atualizações e gestão de comunidades.

  • Vivência em relacionamento com influenciadores, parcerias estratégicas (IP, publishers, marcas) e ações de PR, com histórico de geração de visibilidade e engajamento.

  • Experiência em liderança de equipes e interface com diferentes stakeholders, incluindo gestão de community manager, agências e creators.

  • Capacidade de desenvolver e executar planos de comunicação integrados (conteúdo, PR, social orgânica), alinhados aos objetivos do negócio.

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em redes sociais, criação de conteúdo e estratégias para crescimento e engajamento de comunidades gamers e devs.

  • Perfil hands-on, com capacidade de planejar e executar ações, incluindo gerenciamento de cronogramas, budget (quando aplicável) e acompanhamento de métricas.

  • Inglês fluente, com segurança para produção de conteúdo, reuniões e contatos com stakeholders internacionais. Espanhol é um diferencial.

  • Organização, pensamento estruturado e visão analítica para interpretar dados e ajustar estratégias continuamente.

Benefícios e Atrações

  • Plano de Saúde e Odonto: plano top de linha da AMIL com desconto de apenas R$1 ao colaborador.

  • Ausência remunerada: 30 dias por ano, a partir de 1 ano de casa.

  • Ajuda de Custo Mensal: R$250,00 no cartão iFood Benefícios para ambiente de trabalho, internet de qualidade e despesas domésticas.

  • Crescimento Pessoal: saldo de 70 dólares (aproximadamente R$345,00) por semestre para cursos, livros, workshops, etc.

  • 4 Days Off 4you: 4 dias de folga por ano para tirar quando quiser.

  • Jogo do Mês: título de até R$360,00 liberado mensalmente.

  • Cupom de 20%: 10 cupons anuais de 20% para a loja.

  • Open English: parceria para aprimorar inglês e/ou espanhol.

  • Wellhub: acesso a academia, saúde mental e nutricional via app Wellhub.

  • AVUS: assistência médica virtual e rede de profissionais em todo o Brasil.

  • Starbem: suporte de saúde mental e descontos em farmácias.

  • Stay: opção de investir em sonhos com flexibilidade de contribuição.

Outros Atrativos

  • Proposta de Stock Options: funcionários com pelo menos 1 ano podem ser escolhidos como sócios.

  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído, colaborativo e com alta transparência.

  • Flexibilidade de horário e encontros de time anuais no Rio de Janeiro.

  • Equipe gamer: entendemos a comunidade de jogos; a empresa valoriza quem joga e quem não joga.

Overview

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Coordinator, Team Services will support organizing internal operations and administrative matters within the Team Services department at the FIFA27 office in Rio de Janeiro. The key requirements are to establish and maintain efficient working relationships within the department and across other functional areas, proactive communication and information sharing, systematic work processes, diligent record keeping, and any other administrative support required by Team Services colleagues. They will provide support in team operations and team facilities (training sites and team hotels), ensuring consistency in overall planning and administrative tasks.

Responsibilities

  • Providing administrative support for Team Services across operational concepts, policies, procedures and documentation and data management;
  • Supporting interactions between functional areas for the delivery of services for all participating teams and referees through specific administrative functions (preparation of materials, agendas, reports, follow-ups and minutes, as needed);
  • Coordinating the overall recruitment, selection and training process for Team Liaison Officers for participating teams;
  • Leading the overall Team Services Volunteer project, including recruitment, management and training of volunteers in cooperation with the Volunteer Management department;
  • Supporting overall IT project development and data input/management (Rate card project, Team Hub App, Power BI, We Track) within Team Services and coordinating the delivery of all services to be provided to teams via these systems;
  • Supporting the preparation and delivery of readiness exercises and training materials for tournament staff and volunteers, as advised by the Senior Team Services Manager;
  • Contributing to the Team Base Camp brochure with provision of adequate information, updating the brochure platform on regular basis;
  • Supporting the preparation and implementation of readiness exercises (simulation exercises) at Team Base Camp Hotels and Training Sites with all member associations involved;
  • Contribute to and support the preparation of maps and drawings for team and referee training sites and hotels (including security perimeters, parking allocation, media facilities, etc.);
  • Supporting the maintenance of other internal project management systems utilized before and during the tournament(s); and any other duties that may be assigned.

Qualifications / Your Profile

  • A minimum of two years of experience in team services (operations and team facilities) as well as in event/project management, ideally at the international level.
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, including both pre-event planning and event implementation.
  • Excellent communicator with strong planning, organizational and administrative skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to consistently deliver at a high standard.
  • Able to work closely and collaboratively with others, while being self-motivated and able to work independently.
  • Able to work with a team on the same projects and, as required, work independently to contribute to projects.

  • Comfortable and flexible when working in an international, demanding and changing environment.
  • Able to adapt to and work well with people from other cultures and/or with other backgrounds.
  • Able to hire, develop, coach, appraise and retain experienced and less experienced employees.
  • Able to understand and adapt to new information quickly, and comfortable with learning new systems.
  • High energy levels, strong negotiation and facilitation skills, excellent communication and presentation skills and positive relationship management abilities.
  • Strong IT skills, including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams), Smartsheet and other planning tools.
  • Familiarity with Power BI, We Track is an asset
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Any additional language skills a strong asset (especially Spanish and French).

Overview

Demand Manager Brazil – Haleon

Lead the process of generation and market sign-off on the most reliable forecast for all products in the market or markets under responsibility, coordinating cross-functional inputs to drive decisions on volumes based on quality data analysis. Provide visibility to improve supply and financial planning processes to optimize inventory, avoid write-offs, and improve customer service. The role is a key stakeholder for the General Manager and Leadership Team in the market(s) represented.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the process of generating an unconstrained and constrained forecast on a monthly basis (core activity in the IBP process).
  • Enable monthly validation of business performance and support decisions to achieve commercial objectives integrated with finance by identifying, analyzing, and defining actions to cover risks or gaps against the Plan.
  • Manage end-to-end demand forecasting across all brands to improve forecast accuracy and enhance customer service levels in line with external benchmarks.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to deliver sales gap closing opportunities as required.
  • Define key forecasting roles and accountabilities across the business to align Sales, Marketing, Trade and Finance and drive a one-number mindset for decision making and forecast transparency.
  • Act as unbiased and neutral Business Partner to the General Manager and LT.
  • Establish and embed revised Demand Forecasting processes to support the Supply Chain Operating Model and Core Commercial Cycle.
  • Establish processes to support key account and trade channel-specific forecast capability to drive service levels and reduce working capital requirements.
  • Manage Demand Forecasting input into key IBP meetings (Demand Review, Supply Review, regional S&OP).
  • Identify and understand forecast changes across short- and long-term horizons to support supply chain action and informed decision making.
  • Ensure seamless handover of demand forecast and market intelligence to supply planning hubs to optimize inventory levels.
  • Integrate Trade Spend/Net Sales inputs to prioritize cost-effective net sales delivery.
  • Lead or contribute to significant projects to transform the operating model, including gross-to-net, complexity reduction, COGs, and working capital improvements.
  • Develop technical and IT capabilities to support baseline statistical modeling and integration of forecast platforms for improved accuracy.
  • Deliver long-range volume forecasts for plan submission and mid-year review.
  • Internally measure and report demand forecasting KPIs to drive improvements in forecast accuracy, bias, working capital, and customer service.
  • Provide a consolidated view of forecast trends and robustness across all Trade Channels/Categories.
  • Lead Brand/Category and Channel forecast input into Demand Review Meetings; challenge Sales/Marketing inputs to align volume and value forecasts across business units.
  • Collaborate with Category & Shopper/Sales and Marketing teams to validate NPI forecasts and assumptions.
  • Recruit and develop talent to support best-in-class forecast capability and performance.
  • Incorporate Sample and Promotional Packs inputs as required; maintain detailed knowledge of all forecast components (statistical baseline, promotions, cannibalization, market intelligence, NPI).
  • Monitor key trends impacting market, sector, and category performance.
  • Support and ensure QMS-compliant processes are in place and followed; promote a safe and compliant working environment.

Why you?

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s in Industrial Engineering, Logistics, or similar
  • At least 3 years as a demand planner or related position
  • Experience managing direct reports

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in supply chain, logistics, demand management, or related fields
  • Proactive in leading and managing information and data from the supply chain
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Leadership and influencing abilities
  • Relationship-building capability
  • Strong customer service awareness
  • Strategic and lateral thinking to deliver large-scale solutions
  • Experience with SAP and Excel; highly developed analytical skills

description:
Join to apply for the Billing Analyst I role at Airswift

Airswift is the leading workforce solutions provider to the STEM industries. For over 40 years Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. Today, we are an integrated team of over 900 employees across 37 countries, supporting over 8,000 contractors globally.

We are a people business – we transform lives through the world of work. We care about wellbeing, community engagement and our planet – we plant a tree for every person placed in a job globally! We have a passion for growth, including investing in the development of our people.

We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction, and engineering sectors.

It\'s a hybrid schedule (3 days at the office per week) in Rio de Janeiro - Cinelândia.

Role Description

The Billing Analyst will have responsibility for specific client accounts in Airswift\'s sales ledger covering the North American region. You will join a strong team based in our Rio de Janeiro office and will be tasked with ensuring fully compliant and timely billing for clients under your remit.

Principle Accountabilities:

  • Assure billing for the assigned client portfolio.
  • Adhere to client billing requirements as per contracts and work orders, call off orders, purchase orders, etc.
  • Liaise closely with consultants on new clients and new client billing requirements.
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of billing, including recharges to clients.
  • Ensure timely delivery of invoices to clients along with a variety of supporting documentation.
  • Ensure reporting to the Supervisor of any un-invoiced, missed, or incorrect amount that is not billed timely manner to the client or becomes aged.
  • Ensure timely response to clients (external and internal) and report to the direct Supervisor of specific customer requests for timely delivery.
  • Report on funded invoices to the billing supervisor accurately and in a timely fashion.
  • Ensure all banking information is correct on invoices as per funded or non-funded category, currency, and billing entity.
  • Follow up on invoices emailed to clients or via consultants to confirm receipt.
  • Reconcile client VMS (vendor management system) with an internal invoicing system to ensure invoices are correctly submitted.
  • Monitor the status of invoices that were previously sent by email, portal, or VMS systems for any rejections that require correction.
  • Ensure intercompany invoices are issued correctly and timely manner between Airswift\'s legal entities.
  • Work to the month-end deadlines.
  • Compare invoices from Tempest (payroll and billing system) to invoices generated in Amalto to ensure all relevant information has been saved in SharePoint and maintained in line with auditing requirements.
  • Import invoices to Dynamics 365 (financial ERP system), and balance payroll and billing Tempest to D365, ensuring all billing has been captured.
  • Complete submittal logs in a timely fashion and attend weekly submittal meetings with the Billing Supervisor.
  • Ensure all invoices and backups are filed in a shared drive and maintained.
  • Complete queries in a 48-hour turnaround (outside of main invoicing schedules) and maintain and complete query log.
  • Liaise with payroll to validate any payroll adjustments affected by credit notes and complete credit note logs for auditing purposes.
  • Review new client contracts with the Billing Supervisor to ensure all requirements are captured.
  • Ensure Bullhorn (client management system) data is correct and highlight errors to consultants and service teams accordingly.
  • Meet accuracy targets in line with KPIS.
  • Purchase order and work order analysis.
  • Maintain and deliver 3rd party reconciliations and advise the billing supervisor of details to pay – this is working with credit control to ascertain paid invoices (pay when paid basis).
  • Communicate with various parties of the PO analysis ceilings to ensure timely delivery of either renewed PO value or extended PO.
  • Support function for MIDE region invoicing as and when required.
  • Be fully involved in working with credit control to reduce DSO and improve the liquidity of Airswift for the North American region.
  • Follow company policies and procedures, guidelines, and standards.
  • Ad hoc duties as and when required.

Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills

description:
Nuuvem

Nuuvem é a maior plataforma de distribuição de jogos digitais da América Latina. Com uma presença consolidada no mercado e uma grande paixão por jogos, procuramos um talento para fazer parte da nossa guilda de proplayers, conquistando muito XP ao longo do caminho.

Estamos construindo algo grande: uma plataforma revolucionária que promete transformar a forma como os jogadores acessam e experimentam games. E, para isso, buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Community Manager Sr para se juntar ao nosso time e liderar a construção e fortalecimento de nossas comunidades em canais estratégicos como Discord, Reddit e X. Esse profissional será responsável por ser a voz da marca junto a jogadores e desenvolvedores, promovendo interações genuínas, coletando feedbacks e transformando-os em insights que impactem diretamente a evolução do produto.

Sua rotina envolverá planejamento e execução de conteúdos e dinâmicas de engajamento, moderação de espaços para garantir ambientes saudáveis e inclusivos, análise de métricas para medir impacto e direcionar estratégias. Comunicação clara, criatividade, visão estratégica e proatividade são essenciais para manter um ecossistema vibrante, seguro e conectado aos objetivos da empresa.

Você se juntará a uma equipe de entusiastas da indústria de jogos e da web altamente qualificados, criando soluções em um ambiente ágil e apaixonado. O trabalho em equipe é essencial , além de ser um buscador de conhecimento e auto suficiente quando necessário.

Esta oportunidade é válida para trabalho remoto . Iremos fornecer todos os equipamentos necessários para você mandar bem no seu trabalho, seja ele onde você escolher ser ! Só precisa garantir uma internet de qualidade.

Responsabilidades

  • Criar, gerenciar e engajar ativamente comunidades em canais prioritários (Discord, Reddit, X/Twitter), promovendo interação contínua entre jogadores, desenvolvedores e a plataforma.

  • Ser a ponte entre comunidade e empresa, coletando feedbacks, transformando-os em insights e ações para a melhoria continua do produto.

  • Comunicar novidades da plataforma (novas features, jogos e melhorias) de forma clara, jovem e acessível, mantendo tom de voz consistente com a marca.

  • Planejar e estruturar rotinas de comunidade: calendário de conteúdos, dinâmicas de engajamento, debates, feedback loops e relatórios de métricas.

  • Moderar espaços oficiais garantindo um ambiente saudável, inclusivo e seguro, com respostas empáticas e postura profissional em momentos de atrito.

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Comunicação, Marketing, Relações Públicas, Jornalismo ou áreas correlatas (ou experiência prática equivalente em gestão de comunidades de games).

  • Experiência comprovada em construção e gestão de comunidades online, especialmente em Discord, Reddit e fóruns de discussão.

  • Inglês fluente para lidar com devs e jogadores internacionais.

  • Conhecimento em métricas de comunidade (engajamento, retenção, feedback qualitativo) e ferramentas de gestão de comunidades sociais/digitais.

  • Noções básicas de marketing digital e criação de conteúdo para diferentes canais (texto, meme, vídeo curto, post multimídia).

Competências

  • Comunicação escrita e verbal clara, empática e adaptável a diferentes públicos (jogadores x desenvolvedores).

  • Proatividade, energia e iniciativa — perfil “self-driven”, capaz de tomar decisões rápidas em contextos de engajamento em tempo real.

  • Autocontrole, paciência e neutralidade ao lidar com situações de crise, críticas ou mensagens hostis.

  • Visão estratégica de comunidade: conecta atividades de engajamento a métricas de negócio/produto e mantém processos organizados (políticas de moderação, logs, cadência de conteúdos).

  • Criatividade para gerar dinâmicas, discussões e ações que aumentem organicamente a relevância e a visibilidade da plataforma.

Importante : não deixe de aplicar caso não tenha todos os conhecimentos ou experiências acima! Sua capacidade de aprendizado e evolução é mais importante do que um "checklist" de conhecimentos e experiências prévias.

Modalidade e Faixa Salarial

A modalidade para essa posição é CLT , com faixa salarial aproximada de R$6.185,00 a R$6.805,00 .

Benefícios

Aqui na Nuuvem oferecemos um saldo mensal de R$830 no Cartão iFood Benefícios que é bandeira Elo, aceito em milhões de estabelecimentos no Brasil na função crédito à vista tanto na categoria alimentação quanto refeição!

title: Senior Instructional Designer
description:
We Offer

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Instructional Designer to lead the design, development, and delivery of innovative e-learning and blended learning solutions in Brazil. In this role, you will combine hands-on instructional design with leadership and project management responsibilities, guiding a team of designers, developers, and external partners while ensuring the delivery of high-quality learning experiences and adherence to our global development framework. Fluency in both Brazilian Portuguese and English are essential.

This is a newly formed role and part of our expansion in Brazil. The successful candidate will bring an entrepreneurial mindset, helping to shape the function and drive local growth, while collaborating closely with our established global teams. You will benefit from clear frameworks and support but also have the opportunity to influence and innovate within our learning design approach.

This is a full-time position based in our training centre in Rio.

Key Responsibilities

Instructional Design

  • Analyse learning needs to scope and design engaging and effective e-learning solutions
  • Develop learning objectives, storyboards and assessments for both e-learning and blended learning products which are aligned with adult learning principles and comply with industry standards
  • Apply instructional design models and learning methodologies to create engaging e-learning experiences which align with Maersk Training’s standards, style guides, processes, procedures and templates.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and coach a team of instructional designers and e-learning developers.
  • Assign and oversee tasks, providing guidance and constructive feedback to ensure quality and consistency of products.
  • Foster a collaborative, innovative, and high-performance team culture.
  • Conduct performance reviews and support team members’ professional development.

Project Management

  • Manage multiple e-learning projects end-to-end, ensuring delivery on scope, quality, timeline, and budget.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, and resource allocation.
  • Work closely with the existing Digital Content Team and L&D Managers in the development of learning products.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for stakeholders, SMEs, and clients, ensuring clear communication and alignment of expectations.
  • Monitor project risks, dependencies, and quality assurance processes.
  • Drive continuous improvement in instructional design processes and project management practices.
  • The confidence to balance competing priorities, and maintain high standards in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

We are looking for

To succeed in the role, you will likely bring:

  • 7+ years of experience in instructional design/e-learning development, including 3–4 years in team leadership or project management.
  • Proven success managing cross-functional teams and complex e-learning projects.
  • Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and organisational skills.
  • Fluency in both Brazilian Portuguese and English, with the ability to adapt learning and communication styles to ensure training is relevant and accessible to both local and international audiences .

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

description:
Overview

Sales Representative, Senior role at American Bureau of Shipping (ABS) — The Senior Sales Representative drives sales performance for ABS’ maritime training offerings. The Sales professional should be comfortable with ambitious targets, managing customer and partner relationships, and coordinating with regional training centers to broker learning solutions that meet customer needs. The professional will be central in articulating the value of ABS’ innovative maritime training solutions, ensuring customer satisfaction, and leveraging industry insights to position and sell maritime client training.

What You Will Do

  • Communicate the value of ABS training offerings to external customers, B2B partners, and internal collaborators.
  • Work with ABS regional academy managers to provide sales support and understand customer needs.
  • Own and manage relationships with ABS training customers and serve as the primary point of contact for sales.
  • Coordinate pre-sales and pre-delivery calls with training customers, leveraging subject matter experts and instructors when necessary.
  • Actively prospect and generate leads for maritime training customers and conduct on-site client visits.
  • Periodically attend training deliveries to better understand customer profiles and cultivate relationships.
  • Collaborate with other business development personnel within ABS to bundle and cross-sell training offerings to a wide range of ABS customers.
  • Strategically expand the buying relationship by identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling.
  • Review evaluation feedback from training participants, monitor and ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Respond to RFPs with proposals that highlight ABS’ strengths in delivering cutting-edge educational technology and compliance training.
  • Collaborate with teams across marketing, product management, and service delivery to ensure cohesive client strategies and high satisfaction levels.
  • Utilizes existing software and services for handling Client Relationship Management (CRM).
  • Provide support to consulting, development, and other sales groups as requested.
  • Attend events, client committees, and industry conferences to represent ABS and its training offerings.
  • Stay abreast of industry trends, particularly in alternative energy sources and digitalization.

What You Will Need

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Sales, Business, Marketing, Maritime Studies, or a related field.
  • At least ten (10) years of robust sales experience preferred, within the international shipping industry, with a proven track record of managing and expanding client relationships.
  • Experience and proven ability to sell to training customers in a B2B, for-profit commercial training market.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills and strong organizational and project management abilities.
  • Willingness to travel to meet clients, attend industry events, and engage with stakeholders across various regions.
  • Understanding of the shipping industry’s operational and regulatory challenges.
  • Strong interpersonal and team skills, including functioning successfully in a cross-functional team.
  • Ability to gain a working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management System.

Reporting Relationships

The Senior Sales Representative reports to a senior member of management within the ABS Learning Organization and has no direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

RINA is currently recruiting for a Senior Asset Integrity RBI Engineer to join its office in Rio de Janeiro within theOperations and Maintenance Engineering Division.

Mission

The Senior Asset Integrity RBI Engineer plays a pivotal role in optimizing inspection strategies within the Oil & Gas facilities or power plant by implementing risk-based inspection methodologies. Their mission is to assess the integrity of equipment and facilities, prioritize inspection activities based on risk assessment, and develop cost-effective inspection plans to ensure asset reliability, safety, and regulatory compliance. #LI-KM

Key Accountabilities

Risk Assessment and Analysis:

  • Conduct risk assessments of equipment and infrastructure using RBI methodologies.
  • Identify and evaluate potential failure modes, consequences, and likelihood of failure.
  • Analyze risk data to prioritize inspection activities according to risk levels.

Inspection Planning and Optimization:

  • Develop risk-based inspection plans tailored to specific equipment and process units.
  • Determine appropriate inspection techniques, frequencies, and inspection intervals based on risk assessment results.
  • Optimize inspection schedules to minimize downtime and maximize asset integrity.

Data Management and Documentation:

  • Maintain comprehensive records of inspection data, risk assessments, and inspection plans.
  • Utilize software tools and databases to manage RBI data and documentation effectively.
  • Ensure accuracy, completeness, and integrity of RBI data for informed decision-making.

Continuous Improvement and Compliance:

  • Identify opportunities for optimization and improvement of RBI processes and methodologies.
  • Stay abreast of industry developments, best practices, and regulatory requirements related to RBI and asset integrity management.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant safety standards, codes, and regulations governing inspection activities.

Communication and Collaboration:

  • Communicate RBI findings, recommendations, and inspection plans to stakeholders, including engineering teams, inspection and asset integrity personnel, and management.
  • Foster a culture of safety, reliability, and continuous improvement within the organization.

Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering General or Chemical Engineering

Qualifications

  • Extensive experience in risk-based inspection, integrity management, or asset reliability engineering within the Oil & Gas facilities or power plant industry.
  • Proficiency in RBI methodologies, such as API RP 580/581, ASME PCC-3, or equivalent standards,
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and perform risk assessments.
  • Familiarity with inspection techniques, non-destructive testing (NDT) methods, and fitness-for-service assessment.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a focus on quality, accuracy, and compliance in all aspects of work.
  • Ceritification in API 571 and API 580 is considered an added value.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English. Spanish is desirable.

description:

Join to apply for the Partner Marketing Director role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We have created a new leadership role, Partner Marketing Director, to drive our Go-To-Market strategy across our partner ecosystem, from silicon to public cloud, through channel and hardware manufacturers. As the publisher of Ubuntu and the leading provider of open source to major technology firms globally, we play a unique role in a variety of innovative value chains (Public Cloud, Cybersecurity, AI, IoT) supporting our partners both technically and commercially.
Reporting to the VP of Marketing you will lead a team of marketing managers running partner programs. You will work closely with our partners to make Canonical their trusted partner to deliver open source based products and solutions. In this role you will ultimately be responsible for maximising the overall ROI of our campaigns supporting our partners motions whether sell-to, sell-through or sell-with.
The partner marketing team is formed of multi-talented marketing professionals, as comfortable formulating joint value propositions as they are about running lead generation campaigns. They have an eye for creating remarkable messages/assets and a hand in the selection of the most effective channels through a complex supply chain. They are passionate about technology, the users of enterprise technology, and are early adopters of advanced partner analytics technologies.
Location: This role is home based in the AMER region.
The role entails

  • Building a marketing strategy that drives pipeline growth and revenue outcomes through key partners – Silicon, IHV, ODM, Channel, GSIs, etc.
  • Aligning with growth, field and product marketing to deliver activities integrated with Canonical's campaigns.
  • Owning the execution of partner campaigns across the funnel from recruitment to demand generation programs.
  • Engaging and elevating the partner community through exceptional content in partnership with the communication, product and alliances teams.
  • Multiplying our partners' impact through programmatic approaches.
  • Crafting bespoke plans and joint value propositions to stand out in the marketplace.
  • Championing our partner collaboration vision both internally and externally.
  • Managing the use of Marketing Development Funds (MDF) whether we receive it or distribute it.
  • Driving the adoption of advanced analytics and reporting tools to continually improve the ROI of partner marketing activities.
  • Mentoring and developing a diverse team of partner marketers covering our whole spectrum of partners.
  • Cultivating a culture of continuous testing and optimization.
What we are looking for in you
  • Strong understanding of the technology ecosystem including Silicon, IHV, ISV, ODM/OEMs, cloud service providers and channels is essential for this role.
  • Demonstrated leadership in aligning diverse partners around Go To Market strategies.
  • Proven track record of developing and executing successful co-marketing programs in the technology space.
  • Experience reporting on complex partner marketing activities and touchpoints.
  • Ability to create a culture of excellence, agility and self-drive in your team.
  • Curiosity with a habit of continuous learning.
  • Outstanding communications skills in English, both verbal and written.
  • Exceptional academic results both at high school and university.
  • Willingness to travel internationally up to 4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.
What we are looking for in you
  • Familiarity with a particular vertical (e.g. Telco, Finance, Industrial, Automotive).
  • Experience in leading distributed teams across different time zones.
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Origin 63 is seeking an experienced Solutions Architect (HubSpot) to act as a senior technical and delivery leader across our Sales and Services teams. This role combines sales support —leading deep technical discovery, designing scalable HubSpot-centric architectures (multi-hub deployments and integrations), and scoping Statements of Work (SOWs)—with delivery ownership of select enterprise client projects.

As part of delivery, you will also serve as a technical escalation point , providing guidance when complex blockers arise and ensuring projects meet quality and timeline standards. Operating at a caliber above our Senior Strategist role, the Solutions Architect sets the technical vision for complex client engagements , bridging the gap between business requirements and technical execution.

You will play a pivotal role in pre-sales engagements by delivering feasibility assessments, solution blueprints, and architecture reviews, while also providing governance and oversight during project delivery . Beyond client-facing solutioning, this role reports directly to the Director of Client Services , manages cross-departmental collaboration (Sales, Strategy, Delivery, Development) to maintain delivery excellence, and leads internal training sessions (Lunch & Learns and beyond) to elevate technical solutioning skills across the team.

This is a full-time position requiring 6 hours of regular overlap with our core collaboration hours (8 AM – 2 PM PT).

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Sales to lead deep technical discovery sessions, capturing both business goals and technical requirements across multiple HubSpot hubs and third-party systems.
  • Conduct fit-gap analyses to evaluate feasibility, risks, and trade-offs between custom development, native HubSpot capabilities, and integration options.
  • Produce detailed solution blueprints, integration maps, and architecture documentation that clearly outline system interactions, data flows, and security considerations.
  • Deliver executive-level presentations and solution demos/POCs to prospects, translating technical concepts into clear business outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Sales on technical proposal content and provide pre-sales input to improve win rates, including responding to RFPs/RFIs.
  • Scope Statements of Work (SoWs) with accurate estimates, identified risks, technical assumptions, and defined success criteria.

Solution Design & In-Project Technical Discovery:

  • Validate proposed solutions with both client and internal stakeholders to ensure alignment, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Translate business objectives into secure, scalable, and maintainable HubSpot architectures, with clear guardrails for implementation.
  • Define integration strategies (APIs, middleware, data syncs) for CRM, ERP, or marketing platforms to support seamless workflows.
  • Establish governance frameworks for data quality, user roles, and ongoing platform management.
  • Contribute to pricing and resource planning discussions by balancing feasibility, cost, and client impact.
  • Maintain a library of reusable solution patterns and documentation to improve future scoping efficiency.

Delivery Oversight & Enablement:

  • Oversee early delivery milestones to ensure alignment with the approved architecture and scopes, adjusting design where necessary based on real-world constraints.
  • Remain available as a technical escalation point during implementation to advise on blockers, integration issues, or unexpected scope changes.
  • Conduct architecture reviews at key delivery checkpoints to confirm adherence to solution design, security best practices, and client requirements.
  • Partner with Project Managers and Implementation teams to proactively identify risks and ensure project health.
  • Lead or participate in post-mortems/retrospectives, documenting lessons learned and updating best practices for future projects.
  • Report to the Director of Client Services, providing regular visibility into solution design quality, project governance, and overall delivery health.
  • Manage and align cross-departmental teams (Sales, Strategy, Delivery, Development) to ensure consistency and quality across all client engagements.
  • Lead 1–2 internal training sessions per month (Lunch & Learns and beyond) to elevate technical knowledge, solutioning practices, and team-wide competency.
  • Define, document, and enforce solutioning standards and best practices, ensuring scalable and repeatable delivery frameworks.

External Representation

  • Act as a senior technical representative of Origin 63 within the HubSpot ecosystem, engaging in sales opportunities (where HubSpot is directly involved) and representing the company at partner events.
  • Build trusted relationships with HubSpot Partner Managers, Sales representatives, and ecosystem stakeholders, demonstrating technical leadership and strategic alignment.
  • Strengthen Origin 63’s external reputation by contributing to case studies, speaking engagements, HubSpot community initiatives, and thought leadership content.

KPIs:

  • Blueprint Delivery: 100% of complex opportunities include documented solution blueprints, integration maps, and data architecture mapping, delivered in a standardized format (e.g., Miro + HubSpot/Confluence).
  • Escalation Support: 100% of escalations acknowledged within 1 business day, with ≥90% triaged and guidance provided within 2–3 business days (for assigned book of business and for projects that were scoped by you).
  • On-Time Projects: ≥90% of projects delivered within the committed timeline (≤2-week grace period).
  • Upsell Contribution: Minimum of 1–2 upsell opportunities tracked per quarter, with signed upsells expected after 90 days of onboarding.

Use your deep C++ skills on Windows and MacOS to build an amazing open source developer experience with Multipass, the workstation mini-cloud at your fingertips which provides Ubuntu and appliance VMs on demand for build, test and prototyping. The Multipass team is hiring a Software Engineer to join our distributed team. We greatly value quality in our code, and great user experience.
Multipass is published for macOS, Windows, and also Linux. Think of it as a workstation mini-cloud. At its simplest you can simply say multipass launch and you will get a new VM on your workstation. You can feed that VM data, just as you would on a public cloud like AWS, Azure or GCP.
The goal is not to be a full cloud of course. The goal is to give developers a local cloud on their workstation, which they can use to run builds in the background, or to try cloud appliances, or to test their own cloud deployments and cloud-init scripts, free of charge. People sometimes use it as a build farm on a shared server, for example.
As a Software Engineer you are expected to play a leadership role designing, mentoring, reviewing and of course coding.
Location : This is a remote position available in the EMEA region only.
What you will focus on

  • Ensure Multipass is easy and intuitive to use
  • Architect new features and design the user experience
  • Write high-quality code to create new features and fix bugs
  • Review code and architecture as part of Canonical's engineering process
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Debug, track down and fix issues encountered by our users
  • Foster the open source community and support customers when needed
  • Travel internationally for up to two weeks, twice a year, for company events
What we are looking for in you
  • Cross-platform development experience on macOS and/or Windows
  • Expertise in modern C++ development
  • Experience with software testing and test-driven development
  • Extremely high personal standards for code quality, testing and design
  • Knowledge of hypervisor technologies such as Hyper-V, VirtualBox, KVM, and QEMU
  • Open source experience and involvement
  • Knowledge of CI systems a plus
  • Capacity to learn quickly about new systems and techniques
  • Excellent communication skills in English - both verbal and written
  • Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
What we offer you

We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Senior Full Stack Engineer, Growth - Contract

At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.

We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.

What You'll Get to Do:

  • Drive cross-product impact: Work across multiple product domains simultaneously—building experiments in Proposals, optimizing onboarding flows, and developing features that directly impact acquisition, monetization, and retention metrics
  • Move fast, responsibly: Operate in a Kanban environment where priorities shift based on experiment results and business needs, requiring you to balance rapid iteration with quality engineering practices
  • Own end-to-end user journeys: Build features that span the entire customer lifecycle—from signup and onboarding to subscription upgrades and hand-offs to implementation teams
  • Pioneer AI-driven experiences: Develop and iterate on novel AI-enhanced workflows and experiments that represent the cutting edge of roofing industry technology
  • Lead with autonomy: Work in a self-directed environment with our product designer and Growth EM, taking ownership of product decisions and driving features from conception to delivery
  • Build with experimentation in mind: Rapidly set up A/B tests and feature variations, prototype new experiences to drive user value, and help us learn and iterate on growth strategies with measurable business impact
  • Develop full-stack solutions: Build performant React components and work with Laravel backend following DDD patterns to create robust, scalable features that maintain code quality while enabling rapid experimentation
  • Make pragmatic trade-offs: Know when to optimize for speed vs. complexity, always considering the unique needs of cross-domain features and growth experimentation
  • Shape the future of roofing software: Join a small, passionate team where your individual contributions directly influence product direction and company growth trajectory

What You'll Bring to the Role:

  • Database expertise : Strong PostgreSQL skills including query optimization, indexing strategies, and performance tuning for multi-tenant SaaS applications
  • Growth engineering mindset: Experience building for experimentation and metrics-driven iteration, with a track record of breaking down complex problems into testable proofs-of-concept and rapid experiments
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively with marketing, product, and design teams, consistently communicating technical tradeoffs to meet both user needs and business requirements
  • Autonomous problem-solving: You’re comfortable with ambiguity and scoping solutions independently, while knowing when to collaborate. You thrive in early-stage environments where priorities shift and individual ownership drives real impact
  • User-centered: You’ll have a deep belief that great products serve users while growing the business, with experience building accessible, reliable experiences that earn customer trust
  • A focus on quality: You value testing and documentation as much as code, and excel at making smart tradeoffs between complexity and speed to ship the right things quickly
  • Curiosity: A genuine motivation to move metrics and grow the business through thoughtful product decisions, not just technical execution

Bonus Points:

  • Direct experience on a growth team or working on acquisition/monetization initiatives
  • Data-driven mindset with curiosity about user analytics and behavioural patterns
  • An eye for visuals. Design skills aren’t required, but you can think critically about existing designs
  • Experience building AI workflows in production, or the curiosity to learn
  • Experience with A/B testing tools (Google Optimize, Optimizely, VWO, etc.)

What we offer (US + Canada)

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

  • 1st week of employment is mandatory PTO! Start your journey with Roofr by decompressing and recharging - we will see you in week 2!
  • 1 Friday off per month (we call those our laundry days!)
  • Company wide paid shutdown for the week between Christmas and New Years
  • Flexible time off
  • 80% employer paid benefits
  • Generous Parental Leave policy
  • We host 2 retreats per year and great team building activities
  • Ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career
  • Home office setup stipend
  • Internet and phone allowance
  • Remote first culture
  • Weekly Friday paydays!

At Roofr, we’re big fans of AI. It helps us write job descriptions that don’t put you to sleep, takes notes during interviews so we can actually listen, and even helps us track down awesome humans like you.

Feel free to use AI to prep, research, or get pumped up for your interview (we see you, ChatGPT power users ). But when it’s time to chat, we’d love to meet you, not your AI alter ego. Bring your real, unfiltered self, we promise we will too.

And don’t worry, a real, live human is behind every part of our process. Every application is reviewed by a real person, and you’ll always speak with real humans throughout the interview process. No bots, just good people ️

About Siena
Siena is building enterprise empathic AI Agents powered by reasoning-adept LLMs. Siena is the first AI Agent of its kind, designed to integrate with existing systems and interact with customers across multiple channels from a single, unified platform.
If you're excited about the intersection of human-to-machine communication and want to be part of a team driving innovation and making a real impact in automating agentic workflows, join us on our mission to revolutionize customer experience through empathetic AI.
Our AI-First Philosophy
At Siena, AI isn't just a tool—it’s embedded in our DNA. We believe that leveraging AI-first workflows empowers individuals to work smarter, faster, and more creatively. Our team embraces AI-powered augmentation in everything we do, from research to execution, making us more efficient and innovative every day.
About The Role
As a Full Stack Engineer at Siena, you’ll own projects end-to-end, developing and optimizing features within our AI-powered customer support automation platform. You’ll work closely with product and engineering teams, shaping our roadmap while building reliable, high-performance systems. This role is for engineers who love solving real-world problems, thrive in fast-moving environments, and take pride in shipping great products.
What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable features across the full stack (frontend, backend, and infrastructure).
  • Collaborate closely with Product to break down scope and deliver in iterative, high-impact releases.
  • Work on an AI-first product, integrating cutting-edge LLM capabilities into enterprise customer support workflows.
  • Solve complex engineering challenges, from optimizing API performance to refining microservices architecture.
  • Maintain and improve our cloud infrastructure (AWS) with a DevOps mindset.
  • Share knowledge and mentor teammates, fostering a strong engineering culture.
Who You Are
  • 7+ years of software engineering experience in Node.js, React, TypeScript, and Express.
  • Solid experience with cloud environments (AWS – Fargate, Lambda, EC2, SQS).
  • Strong database skills with PostgreSQL and Redis.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (CodePipeline, GitHub Actions, or similar).
  • Product-focused mindset—you think beyond just code and care about business impact.
  • Deep experience in microservices architectures and scalable systems.
Bonus Points
  • Experience with Next.js and LLM integrations.
  • Infrastructure as Code (CDK, Terraform).
  • Python programming skills.
  • Event-driven architecture experience.
  • Background in customer support software.
Why Join Us
We’re a startup, so no fancy offices or corporate fluff. But here’s what we do offer:
  • Make a real impact. Your work directly shapes our product and company.
  • A Voice that matters. In a small team, every perspective counts—yours included.
  • Working at Siena. We are a fully remote, globally distributed team working at the bleeding edge of CX and generative AI.
  • Competitive compensation. Great salary plus the opportunity for equity or stock grants.
  • Flexible time off. Take at least 15 days—more if you need it.
  • A Learning budget. If you're growing, so are we.
  • The thrill of building something new. Join us at a stage where your contributions matter most.
  • Tackling meaningful challenges. We’re redefining how work gets done through AI.
Our values
We’re not about corporate jargon—here’s what truly matters to us:
  • Curiosity and creativity: You always seek new knowledge, ask questions, and explore different perspectives to deepen your understanding.
  • Customer empathy: You are driven by our customers’ success. You see needs they can’t articulate.
  • Resilience: You bounce back from setbacks, adapt to change, and thrive in the face of challenges.
  • Ownership and autonomy: When things break, you fix first, explain later.
  • Relationships: You create bonds with your colleagues - building trust and sharing success.
  • Craft and speed: You balance vision with pragmatism. Your standards pull everyone higher.
  • Open and direct: You share and receive feedback. You are open about what’s working and what not.
AI-First Tooling
